units.source_text: 正月十八日宫中赛射，夕雾在六条院备办还飨，非常讲究，拟请诸亲王都来参与。

en.t: On the eighteenth day of the first month there was an archery contest at court, and Yugiri prepared an elaborate return banquet at Rokujo-in, intending to invite all the princes to attend.

units.source_text: 到了那天，诸亲王中成人者皆赴会。

en.t: When the day arrived, all the princes who had come of age attended the gathering.

units.source_text: 明石皇后所生诸皇子，个个长得气宇轩昂，眉清目秀。

en.t: The imperial princes born to Empress Akashi were all dignified in bearing and handsome in feature.

units.source_text: 就中这匂兵部卿亲王尤为佼佼不群。

en.t: Among them, Prince Niou, the Minister of War, stood out above all the rest.

units.source_text: 惟有叫作常陆亲王的四皇子，是更衣所生，也许是因此之故，看来容姿远不及其他诸皇子。

en.t: Only the fourth prince, known as Prince Hitachi, had been born to a lesser consort, and perhaps for that reason his appearance seemed far inferior to that of the other princes.

units.source_text: 赛射的结果，照例左近卫方面获得优胜，而且比往年结束得早。

en.t: As for the result of the archery contest, the Left Guards side won as usual, and it ended earlier than in previous years.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大将便从宫中退出，与匂兵部卿亲王、常陆亲王及明石皇后所生五皇子同乘一车，赴六条院去。

en.t: Yugiri, the Left Commander, then withdrew from the palace and rode in the same carriage with Prince Niou, Prince Hitachi, and the fifth prince born to Empress Akashi, setting out for Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 宰相中将薰君属于赛败方面，默默地退出宫廷。

en.t: Lord Kaoru, the Consultant Captain, had belonged to the losing side and quietly left the court.

units.source_text: 夕雾拉住了他，说道：“诸亲皇都到六条院去，你来送送他们吧。”

en.t: Yugiri stopped him and said, "All the princes are going to Rokujo-in, so come along and escort them."

units.source_text: 夕雾的儿子卫门督、权中纳言、右大弁，以及许多公卿都劝他去。

en.t: Yugiri's sons, the Captain of the Gate Guards, the Provisional Middle Counselor, and the Major Controller of the Right, as well as many courtiers, all urged him to go.

units.source_text: 于是分班乘车，同往六条院进发。

en.t: So they divided themselves among the carriages and set out together for Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 从宫中到六条院，颇有一段路程，其时空中飘着小雪，黄昏景色十分清艳。

en.t: It was quite a distance from the palace to Rokujo-in, and as light snow drifted through the air, the evening scenery was exquisitely clear and beautiful.

units.source_text: 车子载着悠扬悦耳的笛声，进入六条院去。

en.t: The carriages entered Rokujo-in carrying the mellow, pleasing sound of flutes.

units.source_text: 除了这里以外，哪里找得到一个西天佛国，在这时候能有此种赏心乐事呢？

en.t: Apart from this place, where could one find a Western Paradise that offered such a delightful pleasure at such a time?
